title: Psoriasis Biologic Classes
subtitle: TNF-α inhibitors vs IL-17 inhibitors vs IL-23 inhibitors

features.name: U.S. plaque-psoriasis-approved agents (not all class members)

values.tnf: Adalimumab, etanercept, infliximab, certolizumab pegol. Golimumab has PsA indications, not a U.S. plaque-psoriasis indication.
values.il23: Guselkumab, risankizumab, tildrakizumab. Mirikizumab is an IBD drug, not U.S.-approved for plaque psoriasis.

values.tnf: PsA ★ (all 5 agents); IBD (adalimumab, infliximab, certolizumab) ★; ankylosing spondylitis. PREFERRED when IBD comorbidity. Certolizumab PREFERRED in pregnancy.
values.il17: PsA indications include secukinumab, ixekizumab and bimekizumab, not brodalumab. Assess axial disease and IBD separately; indications and precautions are agent-specific.
values.il23: Guselkumab and risankizumab have PsA and IBD indications; tildrakizumab does not inherit these class-wide. Mirikizumab is not a plaque-psoriasis option. No universal safest-class ranking is established here.

features.name: Black box warnings and key safety signals

values.tnf: Boxed serious-infection and malignancy warnings. Screen for TB and HBV; assess demyelination and heart failure. Formal contraindications vary: do not translate a precaution into a universal class contraindication. Infliximab doses >5 mg/kg are contraindicated in moderate/severe heart failure.
values.il17: Brodalumab has a suicidality boxed warning/REMS and a Crohn disease contraindication. Other agents have their own IBD precautions. Candidiasis frequency is drug-, dose-, indication-, and trial-specific, not a uniform 10–20% class rate. Bimekizumab requires liver testing and mood-risk assessment.
values.il23: Evaluate infections, TB, hypersensitivity and product-specific hepatic risks. IBD regimens have liver-monitoring requirements. Absence of a boxed warning does not establish a class as the safest or prove absence of malignancy risk.

values.tnf: Adult plaque-psoriasis examples: etanercept 50 mg SC twice weekly for 3 months, then weekly; infliximab 5 mg/kg IV at weeks 0, 2, 6 then every 8 weeks. Adalimumab and certolizumab have product-specific loading and maintenance schedules. Golimumab is not a U.S. plaque-psoriasis regimen.
values.il17: Adult plaque psoriasis: secukinumab weekly at weeks 0–4 then every 4 weeks; ixekizumab 160 mg load then 80 mg every 2 weeks through week 12, then every 4 weeks; bimekizumab 320 mg at weeks 0, 4, 8, 12, 16 then every 8 weeks (consider every 4 weeks when ≥120 kg); brodalumab 210 mg at weeks 0, 1, 2 then every 2 weeks. Other indications/ages differ.
values.il23: Adult plaque psoriasis: guselkumab 100 mg SC at weeks 0 and 4 then every 8 weeks; risankizumab 150 mg and tildrakizumab 100 mg at weeks 0 and 4 then every 12 weeks. Do not transfer IBD induction/maintenance schedules to skin disease; mirikizumab is not included.

values.tnf: Follow the individual label and local TB guidance. Exclude active TB and arrange appropriate latent-TB treatment when indicated; biologic timing requires risk assessment and specialist coordination, not automatic completion of a nine-month regimen.

values.tnf: Use an individualized maternal-disease and reproductive-risk assessment with the exact drug label. Certolizumab has minimal placental transfer, but that does not make all TNF agents interchangeable. Infant live-vaccine timing varies by drug, timing of exposure, jurisdiction and vaccine; a universal six-month rule is not appropriate.

features.name: Time to assess response and monitoring

values.tnf: Assess at 12 weeks. Therapeutic drug level monitoring available for adalimumab and infliximab (detect antidrug antibodies). Annual screen: CBC, LFTs. Infliximab: pre-infusion checks each visit.
values.il17: Assess response at an agent-appropriate interval and monitor infection, candidiasis, IBD and mood symptoms where applicable. Bimekizumab: liver enzymes, alkaline phosphatase and bilirubin before treatment and periodically thereafter; do not label the entire class as requiring no labs.
values.il23: Agent- and indication-specific monitoring applies. Liver monitoring for IBD differs from psoriasis regimens. Assess symptoms and response without assuming durable efficacy removes the need for safety surveillance.
